correctness.rationale: Exact critical tanh flow and convex jump yield global strict sup-norm attraction. The variation-of-constants deficit is positive, cubic and has an explicitly computed asymptotic coefficient. Stationary left Perron projection gives s_{n+1}=s_n-C s_n^3+o(s_n^3); stable difference contracts and s_n>0, which proves both sharp amplitudes. Derivatives give strict opposite dwell orderings per jump versus per time. Five reproducible 60,000-step simulations and algebraic identities corroborate the proof without certifying infinite-time limits.

value.rationale: The first pitchfork is a physically motivated degeneracy in a newly studied heterogeneous human-robot dyad. A neutral linear eigenvalue gives neither global convergence nor a quantitative physical-time rate. This result supplies an exact critical amplitude for both opinion coordinates, a rigorous nonovershoot basin and an actionable distinction between iteration-frequency and real-time performance; no broader or downstream theorem is presumed.
